description: This Java class defines event handlers related to product search operations, including adding/removing products or features from categories, expiring search results, exporting product lists, and managing product search constraints within a web application framework.

classes.name: ProductSearchEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods handling product search-related events in the application, such as modifying search results, exporting data, and managing search constraints.

methods.name: searchRemoveFromCategory
methods.description: Removes products from a specified category based on current search results.

methods.name: searchExpireFromCategory
methods.description: Sets the 'thruDate' of products in a category to expire them, based on current search results.

methods.name: searchAddToCategory
methods.description: Adds products from current search results to a specified category with a given 'fromDate'.

methods.name: searchAddFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature to all products in current search results.

methods.name: searchRemoveFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature from all products in current search results.

methods.name: searchExportProductList
methods.description: Exports the current search results as a list of products with associated categories and features.

methods.name: getProductSearchResults
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over the current product search results based on session constraints.
